description: Defines classes and functions for managing fixed argument vectors, including access, modification, and registration mechanisms within the header-checker tool.

classes.name: FixedArgv
classes.description: Manages a vector of command-line arguments, providing methods to access, resize, and manipulate arguments.

classes.name: FixedArgvAccess
classes.description: Provides controlled access to a FixedArgv instance, ensuring proper resizing upon destruction.

classes.name: FixedArgvRegistry
classes.description: Implements a registry for functions that operate on FixedArgv instances, allowing registration and application of such functions.

methods.name: GetArgv
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the array of argument strings.

methods.name: Resize
methods.description: Resizes the argument vector to a specified size.

methods.name: GetLastArg
methods.description: Retrieves the last argument matching one of the provided options.

methods.name: IsLastArgEqualFirstOption
methods.description: Checks if the last argument equals the first specified option.

methods.name: PushForwardArgs
methods.description: Appends new arguments to the argument vector, inserting '--' if not present.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies all registered functions to a given FixedArgv instance.
